fusions.name: Bellied Gust
fusions.desc: A bolt of wind that deals 8 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Broadside Shove
fusions.desc: Swings the haft broadside, dealing 14 damage, leaving the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocking it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sea Legs
fusions.desc: When you have travelled a distance on foot, you restore 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
